opening.argument: The presentation solicits $500 to $3,500 mining-pool investments, tying those purchases to cryptocurrency mining with daily payments based on the amount mined. A displayed menu reinforces the solicitation by showing four priced pools, each with a “Comprar ahora” button. The income proposition expands through recruitment: participants are told that adding new investors to their team can produce much more income, while a binary-bonus slide displays team branches and a $200 cycle. The presentation also supplies a BitClub Network signup URL. These features establish a paid mining and node-return scheme, although the records do not establish any purchase, payment, loss, or whether the mining and bonus claims were verified.
